about: The devlog's history (MARKETING-SITE MS14). New entries come from the build: any commit on main with a `Devlog: <one plain sentence>` line in its message is listed by date, newest first, above these.

entries.text: Project Wildshard has a home: this site, built the way the game is, by Claude Code agents.
The grid is public: walk a 3 × 3 grid of shards without a loading screen.
Signal Dunes is the first shard to win its boss fight with no screen at all, and replay it byte for byte.
Every shard now fits in 1 GB of memory on the phone.
